title: Arvind Fashions targets sustained growth through retail and online push: Kulin Lalbhai
summary: Arvind Fashions is sharpening its focus on long-term growth by strengthening its direct-to-consumer engine, expanding its retail footprint, and accelerating investments in online channels. Kulin Lalbhai, Vice Chairman & Non-Executive Director of the company, remains confident about sustaining momentum through a combination of store additions, category expansion, and improving productivity across core brands.

title: Vedanta demerger: Five group companies to list between April 1 and May 15, says CFO Ajay Goel
summary: Vedanta will complete the listing of its five demerged entities between April 1 and May 15, 2026, Group Chief Financial Officer Ajay Goel said, outlining the timeline for the group’s restructuring plan. Goel said April 1 will be the effective date for the split.

title: Canara Bank Q3 Updates: NII jumps marginally by 1%
summary: Canara Bank Limited announced its results for the quarter ended December 2025. The business said that Net Interest Income (NII) for the period witnessed 1.10% y-o-y growth to ₹9,252 Crore. Street estimates pegged a figure of ₹9,453 Crore.

title: Godrej Properties Expands Pune Presence with 8.5 Acre Land Acquisition
summary: Godrej Properties Ltd said it has acquired an 8.5 acre land parcel in Mahalunge, Pune, with an estimated revenue potential of ₹2,000 crore. The company said the land acquisition was completed through an outright purchase. The land parcel is located in the fast growing Mahalunge micro market.

title: RIL shares weak, HDFC Bank rebounds, ICICI Bank slips — What are Anil Singhvi’s key levels to watch?
summary: Reliance Industries, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank showed mixed trends in Friday’s trade, with market expert Anil Singhvi highlighting key technical levels to watch. Reliance Industries was trading at Rs 1,387.50, down Rs 4.40 or 0.32 per cent.

title: Prestige Estates Q3 results: Profit jumps 8 times to ₹245 cr
summary: Bengaluru-based Prestige Estates is one of the leading real estate developers in the country. Realty firm Prestige Estates Projects Ltd on Thursday reported a nearly eight times jump in consolidated net profit to ₹244.7 crore in the third quarter of this fiscal year on higher income.

title: Prestige Estates Q3 results: Profit jumps 8 times to ₹245 cr
summary: Realty firm Prestige Estates Projects Ltd on Thursday reported a nearly eight times jump in consolidated net profit to ₹244.7 crore in the third quarter of this fiscal year on higher income. Its net profit stood at ₹32.2 crore in the year-ago period.

title: Syrma SGS shares surge up to 11%, set for best January since listing after strong Q3
summary: Shares of Syrma SGS Technology Ltd. gained as much as 11% on Friday, January 30, after it reported a strong set of third quarter earnings, surpassing Street estimates. The stock then cooled of slightly from the opening highs.

title: ICICI Bank to discontinue select credit card rewards from February 1
summary: ICICI Bank will discontinue select credit card rewards and revise earning limits on specific spending categories from February 1, as part of changes to benefits across its retail credit card portfolio. From February 1, the bank will withdraw the complimentary BookMyShow movie benefit on its Instant Platinum Credit Card variants.

title: Godrej Properties acquires 8.5 acre land in Pune with estimated revenue potential of ₹2,000 crore
summary: Shares of Godrej Properties Ltd. are in focus on Friday, January 30, after the company said it has acquired an 8.5 acre land parcel in Mahalunge, Pune with an estimated revenue potential of ₹2,000 crore. The company said the land acquisition was via an outright purchase in the fast-growing micro-market of the area.

title: Paytm, Swiggy's Q3 numbers; Economic Survey insights
summary: Happy Friday! Paytm reported a strong profit and a jump in revenue in the December quarter.

title: Tata Motors CV shares in focus after strong Q3, management commentary
summary: Shares of Tata Motors' commercial vehicle (CV) business will be in focus on Friday, January 30, after the company reported a healthy set of December quarter results post market hours on Thursday. The third quarter numbers were aided by strong volume growth and sustained margin performance.

title: Versova-Bhayandar Coastal Road work begins after mangrove cell nod
summary: Mumbai: Full-scale construction of the 26.3-km Versova-Bhayandar Coastal Road has begun after the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) received a crucial working permission from Maharashtra’s mangrove cell, marking a major milestone for the long-pending ₹22,000-crore infrastructure project.

title: Officer layered proceeds of crime to conceal fraud: ED charge sheet
summary: MUMBAI: The Enforcement Directorate (ED)’s money-laundering probe related to a suspended Bank of India (BOI) officer found that he had allegedly misused loopholes in the banking system and breached the trust of colleagues by dishonestly using their user IDs.

summary: Voltas Ltd and Blue Star Ltd showed broadly flattish revenue growth for the quarter ending December (Q3FY26). However, a closer look at the numbers reveals the slowdown has played out differently for these companies.
